retrieval_method: Official/public pages read with research fetch_page; GitHub repository metadata/files read with authenticated gh; local rasters and scripts inspected directly. A page or file listing is not binary acquisition or organizer authentication.

claims: Target objects are geological faults indicative of geothermal resources; initial test labels are expert-identified faults absent from the public USGS database.
Metric is distance-weighted Tversky with alpha 0.2, beta 0.8 and a 300 m triangular kernel.
Submission is a single-layer float32 GeoTIFF with values in [0,1], matching CRS/resolution/bounds; the text requires null or NaN outside the bounds.
official_sources.limits: No hidden labels, per-account slots or submission receipt are exposed.
This is not an artifact-linked submission-page receipt and not this project's score.

claims: Official baseline provides CPU and GPU environment options.
official_sources.limits: The baseline does not establish this repository's model performance or provide the hidden test labels.

official_sources.access: release description and ScienceBase attached-file listing read
claims: Area 1 and Area 2 are overlapping surveys with different flight specifications.
ScienceBase lists 22103_area1_grids.zip at 42.43 MB and 22103_area2_grids.zip at 227.39 MB, plus outlines and flight paths.
Radiometrics inform surface geology/soil composition; magnetics inform subsurface structure/geology; variable terrain clearance is an interpretation caveat.
official_sources.limits: No Area 1/Area 2 archive was downloaded, hashed, co-registered or used in an experiment.

claims: Quaternary Faults v2.zip is publicly listed at 5.85 MB and supersedes v1.
The compilation includes fault, volcanic, thermal, geodetic, geophysical and well/spring datasets.
official_sources.limits: The v2 shapefile archive was not downloaded or hashed; metadata is not local geometry.

official_sources.access: exact mirrored text inspected with gh
claims: FCODE2023 distinguishes continuous/accurate, discontinuous/accurate and inferred fault locations.
MAPSCALE encodes mapping scale; RECNUM, SLIPRTNUM, DIPDIRECT and SLIPSENSE are separate attributes and may be unknown or unspecified.
official_sources.limits: Mirror inspection is not organizer authentication. Full geometry is required before per-trace use; centroid-only CSVs are insufficient for assigning attributes along every pixel.
